description: Two low frequency oscillators, each with a shape that morphs continuously, its own symmetry control and its own sync and hold inputs.

params.text: The rate of the second oscillator.
The rate of the first oscillator.
Morphs the first oscillator's shape through triangle, sine, rounded square and square.
Morphs the second oscillator's shape through triangle, sine, rounded square and square.
Skews the first oscillator's shape, moving the peak towards one end of the cycle or the other.
Skews the second oscillator's shape, moving the peak towards one end of the cycle or the other.
Sets the rate range both oscillators cover: up is the fastest, middle is the range meant for one-volt-per-octave control, down is the slowest.

inputs.text: A clock for the second oscillator: a rising edge restarts its cycle, and the FQ knob is then read as a division of that clock.
Holds the second oscillator's output at its present value while this is low, and lets it run while it is high.
Holds the first oscillator's output at its present value while this is low, and lets it run while it is high.
A clock for the first oscillator: a rising edge restarts its cycle, and the FQ knob is then read as a division of that clock.
Returns the first oscillator to the start of its cycle on each rising edge.
Returns the second oscillator to the start of its cycle on each rising edge.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
